Marketplace.CurrencyChoice:
<Color:R=0.73 G=0.73 B=0.72>Welcome to the APB Marketplace. There are two currencies in APB:<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1>

APB Dollars: <APB_Images:APBCash;XL=16 YL=16 Resize=TRUE HUDIcon=TRUE><Color:R=0.73 G=0.73 B=0.72>
These are earned in-game as you play, and can be used to buy clothing, weapons, and other items from Contacts and the Customization Studios.<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1>

Realtime World Points: <APB_Images:RTWPoints;XL=16 YL=16 Resize=TRUE HUDIcon=TRUE> (RTW Points for short.)<Color:R=0.73 G=0.73 B=0.72>
These can be purchased on our website and are used to pay for game time in the Action Districts.

Either currency may also be earned (or spent) by trading items on the Marketplace.<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1>


Which auction house would you like to view?<Color:R=0.73 G=0.73 B=0.72>
The Marketplace has separate auction houses for trading in APB Dollars or in Realtime World Points, and you may only view one at a time. Which would you like to view now?

Note: you can change your selection whenever you like, by using the buttons in the top left corner of the Marketplace UI.
